## What changed

Describe the user-visible behavior and why it changed.

## Validation

- [ ] Tests cover the change.
- [ ] `uv run ruff check althea_mcp tests` passes.
- [ ] `uv run ruff format --check .` passes.
- [ ] `uv run pytest -q` passes.
- [ ] Installation or configuration docs are updated when needed.
- [ ] Logs, fixtures, and screenshots contain no private data or credentials.
